about: Read by AFK Realm (https://github.com/aspollon/AFK-Realm) when it builds the server. Without AFK Realm, apply the patch and build the client patch yourself: see README.md.

patches.name: New races lean on a stock race
patches.why: A race this module makes playable starts in the outfits of its base race, may learn the skills that race may learn, and gets the racial abilities of Conquest of Azeroth that race gets.

client.why: The race choice of the character creation shows the races chosen in CustomRaces.Races, each with the faction of its base race: the game client already carries their models, skins and hair, and the patch makes them playable for 30 classes, with names, start outfits and the showcase of the classes of Conquest of Azeroth of their base race.
